prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: Britney Spears’ first feature film was **_Crossroads_**, released in the U.S. on February 15, 2002. At that time, David Fincher’s most recently released feature was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**; _Panic Room_ followed in March 2002.
